summary.text: Multicolored overlord flowers are huge rank seven immortal flowers used as food for Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu.

claims.text: Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu feeds on multicolored overlord flowers. Each mature flower is extremely huge and can cover an enormous surrounding range. For the flower to mature it needs large amounts of illumination, intense sweet scents, and pearl soil. That demand is many times harder than for flowing light fruits. Flowing light fruits are only a rank six immortal material, while multicolored overlord flowers are rank seven.

Large-scale planting needs those three conditions. Illumination is the hardest for Fang Yuan’s aperture at that time: about a hundred light path dao marks give some light, but not enough for these flowers. Using aurora lights from flowing light fruits would ruin his flowing light fruit plans, because that light is consumable and then has no source. Sweet scents and pearl soil are easier to obtain; pearl soil is sold on a large scale in treasure yellow heaven and is not expensive.

In Mini White Heaven, remnant heavenly dogs and eagle hounds share the sky with some multicolored overlord flowers, and light already makes the environment conducive. Earlier kills of light path Gu Immortals increase light path dao marks in the immortal aperture.

Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu still feeds on multicolored overlord flowers, and mass planting still needs illumination, sweet scents, and pearl soil. Light shine fungi would solve mass production of the flowers. Their scale is still far from optimal: Fang Yuan has too few light path dao marks, and not all of them can gather at the flowers while other lifeforms also need light.

Mini White Heaven holds a field of multicolored overlord flowers. After modified pure white light shine fungi are placed there, the flowers become energized. Like aurora lights, they need intense lights, and the floating fungi help those areas. Developing that field is meant to satisfy the food requirements of Wisdom Sword Gu.
